prompt: Who among the people who proposed the three-stage system in an article titled "Stone Age Cultures of South Africa" was a civil engineer?
answer: Clarence (Peter) van Riet Lowe was the civil engineer. He co-authored *The Stone Age Cultures of South Africa* (1929) with A. J. H. Goodwin and was trained and employed as a civil engineer before becoming an archaeologist.
